channel.title: APERTURE Studio seasonal releases
channel.description: Individual APERTURE Studio printables, images, and interactive companions for family, school, and community publications.

item.title: Thanksgiving Table Draft
item.description: Four foldable Thanksgiving place cards give each guest space for a name and a conversation prompt. Print one free US Letter sheet.
item.dc:creator: APERTURE Studio

item.title: Game Day Color Lab
item.description: Color three team swatches, design a look on the face chart, and follow the original Crosswind passing play. One free printable sheet combines football and makeup design.
item.dc:creator: APERTURE Studio

item.title: Side Street City Atlas
item.description: Mark two changes on an original neighborhood map. Use the coordinate key to trace a walk and compare a second route. The atlas prints on one US Letter sheet.
item.dc:creator: APERTURE Studio

item.title: Side Street neighborhood planning game
item.description: Make two street changes, then trace how neighbors can walk to local destinations in the free browser game.
item.dc:creator: APERTURE Studio

item.title: 3D preference studio
item.description: Choose a kit, change three preferences, and explore an illustrative scene. Follow its links to the corresponding edition or creative tool.
item.dc:creator: APERTURE Studio

item.title: Gift Finder for readers and publishers
item.description: Try APERTURE's interest-and-budget gift finder and copy the iframe or direct-link version for use on a host page.
item.dc:creator: APERTURE Studio
